# Bloomko

> Bloomko is a free language-learning app for Android (coming soon) with an AI tutor that runs offline on the phone (Google Gemma). Learners write Chinese characters, Japanese kanji and kana by hand, stroke by stroke, and the app checks every stroke. Progress is tracked with spaced repetition (FSRS) and a calm "garden": a streak plant that grows when you practise.

Website: https://bloomko.eu · Contact: thebloomko@gmail.com

## What Bloomko does
- Handwriting practice: trace and write characters stroke by stroke with feedback on each stroke.
- Offline AI tutor (Gemma on the phone): writes practice sentences from the words you know, checks translations and explains mistakes; nothing has to leave the device.
- Memory tricks and example sentences for every course word.
- Talk: short role-play conversations with the offline AI tutor (café, shop, asking the way…), answered by voice or typing, with gentle corrections.
- Pronunciation feedback (the AI can listen on the phone) and Mandarin tone practice with a pitch graph of your own voice.
- Listening and reading: dictation, 48 graded stories with tap-to-look-up words and comprehension questions.
- Grammar lessons: 470+ grammar points, unlocked as you learn words, with examples built from words you know.
- Words from a photo: on-device text recognition of signs, menus or book pages; new words go into your own list.
- Spaced repetition (FSRS), daily plan, reminders, look-alike character drills, home-screen widget (word of the day), calm nature sounds.
- Sync between devices without an account (encrypted on the device with a private code).
- App interface and course explanations in English, French, Spanish and Japanese.
- Import your own word lists (txt/csv, Anki or Pleco exports).
- Private by design: no account, no ads, no tracking.

## Courses
- Chinese (Mandarin): official HSK 3.0 levels 1–3, about 2,270 words.
- Japanese: hiragana & katakana, JLPT N5–N3, about 3,500 words.
- Slovenian: A1 (preview). More languages planned (Korean, Spanish, French, German).

## Free word pages
- [Chinese words by HSK level](https://bloomko.eu/chinese/): meaning, pinyin, animated stroke order, memory trick and example for each word.
- [Japanese words: kana, JLPT N5, N4, N3](https://bloomko.eu/japanese/): meaning, reading, kanji stroke order, memory trick and example.
- [Sitemap](https://bloomko.eu/sitemap.xml)

## Status
Bloomko is in development; the first public version is coming to Google Play, iPhone later. Sign up on https://bloomko.eu for early access. The home page lets you try writing a Chinese or Japanese character in the browser.
